info.name: Eladrin
info.description: The construction for my custom Eladrin subrace for elves.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: Creatures of magic with strong ties to nature, eladrin live in the twilight realm of the Feywild. Their cities sometimes cross over to the Material Plane, appearing briefly in mountain valleys or deep forest glades before fading back into the Feywild.

tr.td: Autumn: peace and goodwill, when summer's harvest is shared with all
Winter: contemplation and dolor, when the vibrant energy of the world slumbers
Spring: cheerfulness and celebration , marked by merriment and hope as winter's sorrow passes
Summer: boldness and aggression, a time of unfettered energy and calls to action

description.p:
Ability Score Increase.

Fey Step.
You can cast the misty step spell once using this trait. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.
